title: Ops Clipboard — Lite crosscheck and owner clipboard (ad-hoc)
body:
Purpose:
Quick, minimal spreadsheet-style tracker for short-lived cross-functional asks and manual handoffs — meant to be used as a single-pane clipboard for on-call / weekend coverage and ad-hoc owner handoffs. Keep rows tiny, include estimated hands-on time, and a next-action owner.

Snapshot date: 2026-04-11 09:30 PT
Maintainer: Priya Shah (product-ops) — update quickly during async handoffs.

Legend: P0 = production visible / customer impact, P1 = degraded experience, P2 = informational.

ROWS (compact table copied from quick sheet view):
ID | Item title (short) | Owner | Team(s) | Impact (P#) | Est hands-on (min) | Deadline | Current state | Quick next action
OPS-CLIP-01 | EU fallback route mislink | Liam Chen | infra / serving-runtime | P0 | 45 | 2026-04-12 14:00 UTC | partial route wired; EU->US fallback not tested | Run smoke from eu-west-1, confirm logs, toggle fallback flag if pass
OPS-CLIP-02 | Embedding cost spike (prod) | Sofia Reynolds | observability / billing | P1 | 30 | 2026-04-12 EOD | spike correlates to batch B-11; sampled logs attached | Re-run cost query for last 6 hours; temp-limit batch size to 8
OPS-CLIP-03 | Private deploy acceptance test fail - customer A | Ava Martinez | private-deployments / se | P1 | 60 | 2026-04-13 10:00 PT | flaky ingress certs; cert rotation attempted | Coordinate with SE + infra; escalate to SRE if rotation fails again
OPS-CLIP-04 | Dedicated burst claim reconciliation | Priya Shah | finance + dedicated | P2 | 20 | 2026-04-15 | usage mismatch 2% vs expected; needs owner confirmation | Finance to confirm commit window and adjust internal note
OPS-CLIP-05 | Console: missing route metrics on canary | Liam Chen | console-and-tooling | P1 | 40 | 2026-04-12 18:00 PT | dashboard query returns 0 rows for canary routes | Re-index metric stream; if no data, fallback to trace-based count
OPS-CLIP-06 | Short-run KV cache warmer (manual) | Sofia Reynolds | serving-runtime | P2 | 15 | 2026-04-12 morning | manual scripts prepared, awaiting approval | Run warmer on canary, report token latency delta
OPS-CLIP-07 | SE one-off: customer B quick demo env | Ava Martinez | solutions-engineering | P2 | 25 | 2026-04-13 09:00 PT | env spun up, model mismatch in prompt template | Patch prompt template in env, validate with sample convo
OPS-CLIP-08 | Rollback risk check: new batching policy | Priya Shah | platform-engineering / optimize | P1 | 35 | 2026-04-12 12:00 PT | canary shows 3% latency regressions | Run A/B with smaller batch sizes; prepare rollback checklist
OPS-CLIP-09 | Temporary support contact list (weekend) | Priya Shah | customer-success | P0 | 10 | 2026-04-11 23:59 PT | contacts consolidated below | Confirm on-call assignments and SLAs

Quick totals (auto-tally concept):
- Total rows: 9
- P0: 2, P1: 4, P2: 3
- Est total hands-on minutes: 290 (sum of column)

Top 3 priorities for next 6 hours:
1) OPS-CLIP-01 (EU fallback test) — P0
2) OPS-CLIP-05 (console metric fix) — P1
3) OPS-CLIP-02 (embedding cost spike) — P1

Open blockers / unresolved questions:
- OPS-CLIP-01: Need eu-west-1 runbook access (who has perms?) — tagging @lchen
- OPS-CLIP-03: Customer cert chain unusual; need exact cert expiry time from SE
- OPS-CLIP-08: Can we temporarily lower batch size without impacting cost SLAs? finance to advise

Owner quick actions (bullet list):
- Liam: run smoke and post logs to Slack thread; if green, flip fallback and confirm within 30m
- Sofia: cut a short cost query then post sample IDs; add temporary throttles if spike persists
- Ava: coordinate test rerun with SE and attach acceptance test output to OPS ticket
- Priya: ensure weekend contact list is pinned in #ops-clipboard and email CS lead

Notes to self (scratch):
- Keep rows < 10 lines; prefer yes/no next-step phrasing to long prose.
- This sheet is intentionally skinny; for any item that grows > 120min, fork to a dedicated tracker and link back.
- Use "OPS-CLIP-XX" prefix for easy search and Slack notifications.

Links and quick refs:
- Confluence mini-clipboard page: /display/OPS/mini-clipboard
- Jira quick query: project = OPS AND labels in (clip-lite) ORDER BY priority desc
- Slack: #ops-clipboard (pin this doc)

Change log (short):
- 2026-04-11 created by Priya Shah
- 2026-04-13 updated: added OPS-CLIP-08 rollback risk row, refreshed owners

Questions for owners to answer inline (copy to row comment):
- ETA to complete (minutes)
- Confirmed dependent teams (yes/no list)
- Ops follow-up required after completion (Y/N)

End of clipboard. Keep this doc light and delete old rows weekly.
